disqualifier.note: Independent UI axes: disabled is the shared actionsDisabled OR (resolved/reviewBusy/waiting) and selected is whether this proposal is the review-dialog target. Write site assigns them from different sources; all four combinations occur (a selected proposal stays disabled while a review is in flight).

Independently observed facts: hasVerifiedAnchor projects this row's Option verifiedAnchor; selected projects whether selectedSource.evidenceId matches. The inspect button disables without an anchor but still renders pressed independently; a stale selectedSource can leave selected true after the anchor disappears.

Independent disablement causes from three upstreams (disposition Option, review AsyncResult, detail waiting) plus a derived OR. actionsDisabled is a priority conjunction over free combinations, not a masked union; resolved+busy+waiting can all be true together after a just-recorded review.

Ephemeral length predicates over the same reason string. Readers OR them into reasonInvalid and separately Bool.match reasonTooLong for copy; there is no exclusive write/read or coherence check, and the combo is arithmetic rather than a stored state machine readers must reconstruct.
